g.text: Evaluate three distinct design directions for the international clinical SaaS platform. No DEMO badges. Modern, crisp, iconic.
Interlocking CP architecture with precision negative-space clinical cross and kinetic nodes.
✓ Boldest glyph recognition on light and dark
Kinetic radar sweep C + ascending pilot fin with directional navigation diamond.
Swiss minimalist continuous ribbon with centered clinical cross emblem.
✓ Ultra-simple geometry with zero visual noise
✓ Perfect for international healthcare institutional trust
